items.title: Pay locksmith invoice SD-4471
items.quote: Wir bitten um Ausgleich innerhalb einer Woche, nachdem Ihnen diese Rechnung zugegangen ist.
items.computation: The period is one week from receipt of the invoice. The letter has no date and the receipt date is not stated. The sender is a company, so no deemed-delivery rule applies. The final day therefore cannot be determined. If the invoice was received on day X, the last day is X + 7 days (§§ 187, 188 BGB). If that day is a weekend or a NW public holiday, it moves to the next working day.

warnings: The invoice has no date and the receipt date is unknown, so the due date cannot be fixed. Note the day it reached you and add 7 days. For example, receipt on 2026-12-10 gives 2026-12-17.
The payment request is only a request ('bitten um Ausgleich') and is not a statutory deadline. Late payment is not automatically penalised without a reminder.

Emergency locksmith invoices are often overpriced. Check that the price was agreed beforehand and that the surcharges are justified. The letter lists a 'Sonn- und Feiertag, Nacht' surcharge, and 06.12.2026 was a Sunday. You may dispute the amount or pay under reservation.
The invoice arithmetic is correct: 224.00 net + 42.56 VAT = 266.56.
